Load packages
```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsci)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
```
Load data 
```{r}
df <- readRDS("../Data/processed/df_claims.rds")
pts_sa <- readRDS("../Data/processed/pts_sa.rds")
```

# =============================================================================
# STEP 1: Build dual-initiator dataset from claims
# Use ITT dual definition (same-day IPI+NIVO at index)
# =============================================================================
```{r}
dual_pts <- pts_sa %>%
  filter(itt_dual == 1) %>%
  pull(PATIENT_ID)

# Claims for dual initiators only
dual_claims <- df %>%
  filter(PATIENT_ID %in% dual_pts,
         ICI_name %in% c("IPILIMUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB", "PEMBROLIZUMAB")) %>%
  mutate(days_from_index = as.numeric(tx_date - first_ici_date))
```


# =============================================================================
# STEP 2: Classify each claim date as dual or mono
# Dual date = IPI + NIVO on same day
# Mono date = only one of IPI or NIVO (or PEMBRO)
# =============================================================================
```{r}
claim_dates <- dual_claims %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID, tx_date, days_from_index) %>%
  summarise(
    has_ipi      = any(ICI_name == "IPILIMUMAB"),
    has_nivo     = any(ICI_name == "NIVOLUMAB"),
    has_pembro   = any(ICI_name == "PEMBROLIZUMAB"),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_date = case_when(
      has_ipi & has_nivo ~ "dual",
      has_nivo           ~ "nivo_mono",
      has_ipi            ~ "ipi_mono",
      has_pembro         ~ "pembro_mono",
      TRUE               ~ "other"
    )
  )
```

# =============================================================================
# STEP 3: For each dual patient, find the first switch away from dual
# Switch = first claim date where regimen_date != "dual"
# =============================================================================
```{r}
switch_summary <- claim_dates %>%
  arrange(PATIENT_ID, days_from_index) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    last_dual_day    = max(days_from_index[regimen_date == "dual"], na.rm = TRUE),
    first_switch_day = min(days_from_index[regimen_date != "dual"], na.rm = TRUE),
    first_switch_to  = regimen_date[days_from_index == min(days_from_index[regimen_date != "dual"],
                                                           na.rm = TRUE)][1],
    n_dual_dates     = sum(regimen_date == "dual"),
    n_claim_dates    = n(),
    .groups          = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # If no non-dual date exists, first_switch_day = Inf
    ever_switched = is.finite(first_switch_day),

    # Switching category
    switch_category = case_when(
      !ever_switched                          ~ "Never switched (persisted on dual)",
      first_switch_day <= 21                  ~ "Switched at/before cycle 1 (≤21 days)",
      first_switch_day <= 42                  ~ "Switched at cycle 2 (22–42 days)",
      first_switch_day <= 63                  ~ "Switched at cycle 3 (43–63 days)",
      first_switch_day <= 84                  ~ "Switched at cycle 4 (64–84 days)",
      first_switch_day > 84                   ~ "Switched after cycle 4 (>84 days)"
    ),
    switch_category = factor(switch_category, levels = c(
      "Switched at/before cycle 1 (≤21 days)",
      "Switched at cycle 2 (22–42 days)",
      "Switched at cycle 3 (43–63 days)",
      "Switched at cycle 4 (64–84 days)",
      "Switched after cycle 4 (>84 days)",
      "Never switched (persisted on dual)"
    ))
  )
```
# =============================================================================
# STEP 4: Merge age group from pts_sa
# =============================================================================
```{r}
switch_summary <- switch_summary %>%
  left_join(
    pts_sa %>% select(PATIENT_ID, age_75_binary),
    by = "PATIENT_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_75_binary,
                       levels = c("<75", "75+"),
                       labels = c("Age <75", "Age ≥75"))
  )
```
# =============================================================================
# STEP 5: Build survival object for time-to-first-switch
# Event     = first switch away from dual (any non-dual claim date after index)
# Censoring = min(180 days, death, Medicare disenrollment)
# =============================================================================

``` {r}
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

horizon <- 180

surv_data <- switch_summary %>%
  left_join(
    pts_sa %>%
      select(PATIENT_ID,
             ici_index_dt,
             censor_flag_11,
             followup_end_date11,
             mcare_disenroll,
             mcare_disenroll_dt),
    by = "PATIENT_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Days from index to death (censor_flag_11 == 1 => death event)
    days_to_death = if_else(
      censor_flag_11 == 1,
      as.numeric(followup_end_date11 - ici_index_dt),
      NA_real_
    ),
    # Days from index to Medicare disenrollment
    days_to_disenroll = if_else(
      mcare_disenroll == 1 & !is.na(mcare_disenroll_dt),
      as.numeric(mcare_disenroll_dt - ici_index_dt),
      NA_real_
    ),
    # Administrative censoring time = earliest of horizon, death, disenrollment
    censor_time = pmin(horizon, days_to_death, days_to_disenroll, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Event if switch occurred on or before the censoring time
    surv_event = as.integer(ever_switched & first_switch_day <= censor_time),

    # Observed time = switch day if event, else censoring time
    surv_time = if_else(surv_event == 1, first_switch_day, censor_time)
  ) %>%
  filter(surv_time > 0, !is.na(surv_time))

# Quick sanity check — flag any negative censoring dates (data integrity)
cat("=== Survival data sanity checks ===\n")
surv_data %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),
    n_events        = sum(surv_event),
    median_fu       = median(surv_time),
    neg_death       = sum(days_to_death < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    neg_disenroll   = sum(days_to_disenroll < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_died_in_180   = sum(days_to_death <= 180, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_disenr_in_180 = sum(days_to_disenroll <= 180, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

# Figure 8b: KM curve — all dual initiators, no stratification
# =============================================================================
```{r}
km_fit_all <- survfit(
  Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ 1,
  data = surv_data
)

# Summary at cycle boundaries for results text
cat("=== Cumulative switching at each cycle boundary ===\n")
summary(km_fit_all, times = c(21, 42, 63, 84, 105))

fig8b_base <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit_all,
  data          = surv_data,
  fun           = "event",
  conf.int      = TRUE,
  censor        = FALSE,
  risk.table    = FALSE,
  xlab          = "Days from Dual ICI Initiation",
  ylab          = "Cumulative Proportion Switched to Mono ICI",
  title         = "Time from Dual ICI Initiation to Switch to Mono ICI",
  subtitle      = "ITT Dual Initiators (N=106), SEER-Medicare 2016–2019",
  legend        = "none",
  palette       = "#E64B35",
  ggtheme       = theme_classic(),
  font.main     = c(12, "bold"),
  font.x        = 10,
  font.y        = 10,
  font.tickslab = 9,
  xlim          = c(0, 189),
  break.x.by    = 21
)

# Add cycle reference lines
fig8b_base$plot <- fig8b_base$plot +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(21, 42, 63, 84),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(21, 42, 63, 84), y = 0.02,
           label = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"),
           size = 3, color = "grey40", hjust = -0.2)

rkm_fit_all <- survfit(
  Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ 1,
  data = surv_data
)
# Summary at cycle boundaries for results text
cat("=== Cumulative switching at each cycle boundary ===\n")
summary(km_fit_all, times = c(21, 42, 63, 84, 105))
fig8b_base <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit_all,
  data          = surv_data,
  fun           = "event",
  conf.int      = TRUE,
  censor        = FALSE,
  risk.table    = FALSE,
  xlab          = "Days from Dual ICI Initiation",
  ylab          = "Cumulative Proportion Switched to Mono ICI",
  title         = "Time from Dual ICI Initiation to Switch to Mono ICI",
  subtitle      = "ITT Dual Initiators (N=106), SEER-Medicare 2016–2019",
  legend        = "none",
  palette       = "#E64B35",
  ggtheme       = theme_classic(),
  font.main     = c(12, "bold"),
  font.x        = 10,
  font.y        = 10,
  font.tickslab = 9,
  xlim          = c(0, 189),
  break.x.by    = 21
)
# Add cycle reference lines
fig8b_base$plot <- fig8b_base$plot +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(21, 42, 63, 84),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(21, 42, 63, 84), y = 0.02,
           label = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"),
           size = 3, color = "grey40", hjust = -0.2)

# Custom risk table with primary + complementary small cell suppression
times_to_show <- c(0, 21, 42, 63, 84, 105, 126, 147, 168, 189)
risk_summary <- summary(km_fit_all, times = times_to_show, extend = TRUE)

risk_raw <- data.frame(
  time   = risk_summary$time,
  n.risk = risk_summary$n.risk
) %>%
  arrange(time)

# Iterative suppression: primary (n < 11) + complementary (adjacent diff < 11)
apply_suppression <- function(df) {
  df$suppressed <- df$n.risk < 11
  changed <- TRUE
  while (changed) {
    changed <- FALSE
    idx <- which(!df$suppressed)
    if (length(idx) < 2) break
    vals <- df$n.risk[idx]
    diffs <- abs(diff(vals))
    bad <- which(diffs < 11)
    if (length(bad) > 0) {
      for (b in bad) {
        pair_idx <- idx[c(b, b + 1)]
        smaller <- pair_idx[which.min(df$n.risk[pair_idx])]
        if (!df$suppressed[smaller]) {
          df$suppressed[smaller] <- TRUE
          changed <- TRUE
        }
      }
    }
  }
  df
}

risk_all <- apply_suppression(risk_raw) %>%
  mutate(
    n_display = ifelse(suppressed, "*", as.character(n.risk)),
    y_pos = 0
  )

# Inspect what's shown vs. suppressed
print(risk_all %>% select(time, n.risk, suppressed, n_display))

risk_table_all <- ggplot(risk_all, aes(x = time, y = y_pos, label = n_display)) +
  geom_text(color = "#E64B35", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 189), breaks = seq(0, 189, 21)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 0.5),
                     breaks = 0,
                     labels = "All patients") +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    y       = NULL,
    title   = "Number at risk",
    caption = "* Cell suppressed: SEER small cell policy (primary n<11, plus complementary suppression to prevent back-calculation)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x   = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y    = element_text(size = 9, color = "#E64B35"),
    plot.title     = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption   = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid     = element_blank()
  )
# Combine
fig8b_final <- fig8b_base$plot / risk_table_all +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))
print(fig8b_final)

ggsave("../Plots & Figures/fig8a_km_all_patients_noticks_new.png",
       plot = fig8b_final, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# =============================================================================
# Get event counts: Cumulative proportion switched by end of each cycle
# =============================================================================
```{r}
cycle_summary <- summary(km_fit_all, times = c(0, 21, 42, 63, 84, 180))

cycle_table <- data.frame(
  day              = cycle_summary$time,
  cycle            = c("Baseline", "End C1", "End C2", "End C3", "End C4", "Day 180"),
  n_at_risk        = cycle_summary$n.risk,
  cum_events       = cycle_summary$n.event %>% cumsum(),
  surv_prob        = round(cycle_summary$surv, 3),
  cum_switched_pct = round((1 - cycle_summary$surv) * 100, 1),
  ci_lower_pct     = round((1 - cycle_summary$upper) * 100, 1),
  ci_upper_pct     = round((1 - cycle_summary$lower) * 100, 1)
)

print(cycle_table)

```
# =============================================================================
# Distribution of switch destinations among dual initiators who switched
# Restricted to events within the 180-day analytic window
# =============================================================================
```{r}
switch_destination <- surv_data %>%
  filter(surv_event == 1) %>%
  count(first_switch_to, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
    n_pct = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct),
    regimen_label = recode(first_switch_to,
      "nivo_mono"   = "Nivolumab monotherapy",
      "ipi_mono"    = "Ipilimumab monotherapy",
      "pembro_mono" = "Pembrolizumab monotherapy",
      "other"       = "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

cat("=== Switch destination among dual initiators who switched within 180 days ===\n")
cat("Total switchers: N =", sum(switch_destination$n), "\n\n")
print(switch_destination %>% select(regimen_label, n, pct))
```

# Figure 4: Age-stratified KM curve — time from dual ICI to mono ICI switch
# Stratified by age <75 vs ≥75
# =============================================================================
```{r}
# Fit stratified KM
km_fit_age <- survfit(
  Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ age_group,
  data = surv_data
)

# Log-rank test (confirms p = 0.9)
survdiff(Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ age_group, data = surv_data)

# Age-group sample sizes for legend
n_by_age <- surv_data %>% count(age_group)
print(n_by_age)

# Build the figure
fig4_clean <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit_age,
  data             = surv_data,
  fun              = "event",
  conf.int         = TRUE,
  censor    = FALSE,
  pval             = "Log-rank p = 0.9",

  risk.table       = FALSE,
  xlab             = "Days from Dual ICI Initiation",
  ylab             = "Cumulative Proportion Switched to Mono ICI",
  legend           = c(0.2, 0.85),
  legend.title     = "",
  legend.labs      = c(
    sprintf("Age <75 (n=%d)", n_by_age$n[n_by_age$age_group == "Age <75"]),
    sprintf("Age ≥75 (n=%d)", n_by_age$n[n_by_age$age_group == "Age ≥75"])
  ),
  palette          = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5"),
  ggtheme          = theme_classic(),
  font.x           = 10,
  font.y           = 10,
  font.tickslab    = 9,
  font.legend      = 9,
  xlim             = c(0, 180),
  break.x.by       = 21
)$plot +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(21, 42, 63, 84),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(21, 42, 63, 84), y = 0.02,
           label = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"),
           size = 3, color = "grey40", hjust = -0.2) +
  labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

print(fig4_clean)

ggsave("../Plots & Figures/fig4_km_by_age.png",
       plot = fig4_clean, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

Updated Age switching plot with risk set supression:

```{r}
# Fit stratified KM
km_fit_age <- survfit(
  Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ age_group,
  data = surv_data
)
# Log-rank test (confirms p = 0.9)
survdiff(Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ age_group, data = surv_data)

    sprintf("Age ≥75 (n=%d)", n_by_age$n[n_by_age$age_group == "Age ≥75"])
  ),

  ggtheme          = theme_classic(),

)$plot +

             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(21, 42, 63, 84), y = 0.02,
           label = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"),
           size = 3, color = "grey40", hjust = -0.2) +
  labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
# Build risk table with primary AND complementary small cell suppression
# Use summary() to guarantee a row at every requested time point

times_to_show <- c(0, 21, 42, 63, 84, 105, 126, 147, 168)

risk_summary <- summary(km_fit_age, times = times_to_show, extend = TRUE)

risk_raw <- data.frame(
  time      = risk_summary$time,
  n.risk    = risk_summary$n.risk,
  strata    = as.character(risk_summary$strata)
) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = gsub("age_group=", "", strata),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("Age <75", "Age ≥75"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(age_group, time)

# Iterative suppression: primary (n < 11) + complementary (adjacent diff < 11)
apply_suppression <- function(df) {
  df$suppressed <- df$n.risk < 11
  changed <- TRUE
  while (changed) {
    changed <- FALSE
    for (g in unique(df$age_group)) {
      idx <- which(df$age_group == g & !df$suppressed)
      if (length(idx) < 2) next
      vals <- df$n.risk[idx]
      diffs <- abs(diff(vals))
      bad <- which(diffs < 11)
      if (length(bad) > 0) {
        for (b in bad) {
          pair_idx <- idx[c(b, b + 1)]
          smaller <- pair_idx[which.min(df$n.risk[pair_idx])]
          if (!df$suppressed[smaller]) {
            df$suppressed[smaller] <- TRUE
            changed <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  df
}

risk_df <- apply_suppression(risk_raw) %>%
  mutate(n_display = ifelse(suppressed, "*", as.character(n.risk)))

# Inspect before plotting
print(risk_df %>% select(age_group, time, n.risk, suppressed, n_display))

risk_table_age <- ggplot(risk_df, aes(x = time, y = age_group,
                                      label = n_display, color = age_group)) +
  geom_text(size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 189), breaks = seq(0, 189, 21)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Age <75" = "#E64B35", "Age ≥75" = "#4DBBD5"),
                     guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    y       = NULL,
    title   = "Number at risk",
    caption = "* Cell suppressed: SEER small cell policy (primary n<11, plus complementary suppression to prevent back-calculation)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x   = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y    = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title     = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption   = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid     = element_blank()
  )

fig4_final <- fig4_clean / risk_table_age +

print(fig4_final)
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%

  group_by(age_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

               aes(x = age_group, y = pct, fill = switch_category)) +

    "Switched after cycle 4 (>84 days)"       = "#4DBBD5",

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 101)) +
  labs(

    fill  = "Switching Pattern",
    title = "Timing of Switch from Dual to Mono ICI by Age Group",
    subtitle = "ITT Dual Initiators, SEER-Medicare 2016–2019",
```

```{r}
cat("=== Switching pattern by age group ===\n")
switch_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  count(age_group, switch_category) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  mutate(n_pct = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct)) %>%
  select(age_group, switch_category, n_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = n_pct) %>%
  print()

switch_summary %>%
  count(ever_switched) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

switch_summary %>%
  filter(ever_switched) %>%
  count(first_switch_to, sort = TRUE)
```

Generate new time series figure:
```{r}


# =============================================================================
# FDA approval dates (vertical reference lines)
# =============================================================================
approvals <- data.frame(
  date  = c(2011, 2014, 2015, 2015),
  label = c(
    "Ipi approved\n(melanoma, 2011)",
    "Nivo approved\n(melanoma, Dec 2014)",
    "Pembro approved\n(melanoma, Dec 2014)",
    "Ipi+Nivo approved\n(melanoma, Oct 2015)"
  ),
  drug  = c("IPILIMUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB", "PEMBROLIZUMAB", "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB"),
  y_nudge = c(0.88, 0.78, 0.68, 0.58)  # stagger labels vertically
)

# =============================================================================
# Time series data — same as existing ts_dist
# =============================================================================
ts_dist <- pts_sa %>%
  mutate(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS = as.numeric(as.character(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS))) %>%
  count(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, index_regimen) %>%
  group_by(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Label at last year
label_data <- ts_dist %>%
  group_by(index_regimen) %>%
  filter(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS == max(YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(regimen_label = recode(as.character(index_regimen),
    "IPILIMUMAB"             = "Ipilimumab",
    "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "Ipi+Nivo",
    "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "Pembrolizumab",
    "NIVOLUMAB"              = "Nivolumab"
  ))

# Color palette
pal <- c(
  "IPILIMUMAB"             = "#F39B7F",
  "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "#E64B35",
  "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "#4DBBD5",
  "NIVOLUMAB"              = "#00A087"
)

approval_colors <- c(
  "IPILIMUMAB"             = "#F39B7F",
  "NIVOLUMAB"              = "#00A087",
  "PEMBROLIZUMAB"          = "#4DBBD5",
  "IPILIMUMAB + NIVOLUMAB" = "#E64B35"
)

# =============================================================================
# Plot
# =============================================================================
p <- ggplot(ts_dist,
            aes(x = YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS, y = prop,
                color = index_regimen, group = index_regimen)) +

  # FDA approval vertical lines — drop 2011 ipi (outside window)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2014, color = "#00A087",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2015, color = "#4DBBD5",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2015, color = "#E64B35",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +

  # Main trend lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  # End-of-line regimen labels
  geom_label_repel(
    data        = label_data,
    aes(label   = regimen_label),
    nudge_x     = 0.3,
    direction   = "y",
    hjust       = 0,
    size        = 3.2,
    label.size  = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Approval annotations — stacked on right side of each vline
  # Nivo: left of 2014 line
  annotate("text", x = 2013.95, y = 0.97,
           label = "Nivo approved (Dec 2014)", size = 2.8,
           color = "#00A087", hjust = 1, fontface = "italic") +

  # Pembro + Ipi+Nivo: right of 2015 line, clearly separated vertically
  annotate("text", x = 2015.05, y = 0.97,
           label = "Pembro approved (Dec 2014)", size = 2.8,
           color = "#4DBBD5", hjust = 0, fontface = "italic") +

  annotate("text", x = 2015.05, y = 0.88,
           label = "Ipi+Nivo approved (Oct 2015)", size = 2.8,
           color = "#E64B35", hjust = 0, fontface = "italic") +

  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 2013:2019,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Year of Diagnosis",
    y        = "Proportion of Patients",
    title    = "Trends in First-line ICI Regimen Selection in Stage IV Melanoma",
    subtitle = "SEER-Medicare, 2013–2019 | Distant stage at diagnosis",
    caption  = "Dashed lines indicate FDA approval dates. Ipi = ipilimumab; Nivo = nivolumab; Pembro = pembrolizumab."
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50", hjust = 0),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p)

       plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
